title: Peruvian Quinoa Salad
description: A vibrant salad made with quinoa, wholesome ingredients, and inspired by Peruvian flavors.
instructions: 1. Rinse the quinoa in a fine mesh strainer and drain well.
2. In a medium saucepan, heat the vegetable oil over medium heat.
3. Add the diced red onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
4. Add the quinoa to the saucepan and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
5. Add 2 cups of water to the saucepan and bring to a boil.
6. Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15-20 minutes, or until the quinoa is tender and the water has been absorbed.
7. Fluff the cooked quinoa with a fork and let cool to room temperature.
8. In a large bowl, combine the cooled quinoa, diced cucumber, Peruvian corn, and diced tomato.
9. In a small bowl, whisk together a vinaigrette of your choice (e.g., olive oil and lime juice).
10. Drizzle the vinaigrette over the quinoa mixture and toss to combine.
11. Serve the Peruvian Quinoa Salad chilled, garnished with additional Peruvian corn and a sprinkle of chopped cilantro if desired.
